note: Sponsors and reputation (Spec 16; Boss, 31 Oct 2026: in Areas 1 to 4 the area champion's one-off bike offer stands on its own; from Area 5, Sponsored Rides brings contracts, paid only for objectives met, and the reputation table). reputation: the score changes (16.1), 0 to 1000; tierWeight by the kind of race day. cpuPerLevel: a CPU rider's fixed score per level, for the table. offers: how many open when a window opens (after a Local Champion or main championship from fromArea on): base + one per perRep points, up to max; the top tier on offer by the rider's share of the table (topShare: at or above that share of riders beaten, that tier opens; T1 and T2 always). tiers (16.2): pay per objective met in pounds (low to high), days per contract, minimum fitted part grade, early cancellation rate of objective cash received, and sponsor names. objectives (16.3): topN by tier; perDay one or two; a warning after warnAfter failures in a row and the end after endAfter.
